key_insight: crystALL generates structurally diverse candidate ensembles beyond the convex hull, prioritizing stable and metastable configurations rather than ground-state stability alone.
engineering_relevance: Including metastable structures can help engineers interpret experimental materials and investigate properties missed by stability-only searches.
method: Generate candidates through species substitutions using a large relaxed-structure pool.
Analyze candidates in pySIPFENN ML feature space, then select representatives by clustering and energy minimization or property matching.
Build ensembles for validation, searching anonymized compositional ranges when experimental stoichiometry is uncertain.
evidence_signal: The approach draws on 5 million relaxed structures from OPTIMADE and MPDD; the abstract reports no quantitative accuracy or runtime benchmarks.
watch_item: Candidate diversity alone does not establish thermodynamic populations or experimental accessibility; experimental or ab initio validation remains necessary.
paper_title: Data-driven candidate structure ensemble generation beyond the convex hull with crystALL approach
